newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Encore Wire downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Encore Wire downgraded.

text.p: -- Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc Thursday downgraded Encore Wire Corp to market performer from market outperformer based on price appreciation.
-- Rauscher Pierce said its second price objective of $19 to $20 a share, set October 25, has been achieved, yielding nearly 60 percent since August 20.
-- Empire Wire makes copper wire for residential and commercial buildings.
-- The current risk/reward dynamic is less favorable given the likelihood of lower multiples for Encore Wire and the rapid turns in the copper cable market, Rauscher Pierce said.
-- Its stock was trading down 9/16 Thursday at 19-3/8.
